# Vendored OpenAI Codex helpers

The three Python files in this directory are unmodified copies of the official
[OpenAI Codex repository](https://github.com/openai/codex).

- Upstream commit: `84aa75204ad604bcf498df180d128181c89b2f0b`
- Upstream directory: [`codex-rs/skills/src/assets/samples/plugin-creator/scripts`](https://github.com/openai/codex/tree/84aa75204ad604bcf498df180d128181c89b2f0b/codex-rs/skills/src/assets/samples/plugin-creator/scripts)
- License: Apache License 2.0. The upstream license text is preserved in [LICENSE](LICENSE).
- The upstream attribution text is preserved verbatim in [NOTICE](NOTICE).
- Copied files are used to validate marketplace identifiers, read marketplace
  names, and create marketplace entries during installation.

These files were compared byte for byte with the pinned upstream revision.
No changes have been made to the Python files.
